text: {"lessons":["I should judge each holding by its future prospects and fit with my plan, not sell simply to enjoy a gain or avoid admitting a mistake.","Before buying back a stock, I should set a clear investment reason, position size, and price or risk limit rather than act on familiarity or recent price moves.","I should assess my whole account and stay patient through ordinary declines; frequent checking and loss aversion are not reasons to trade without a plan."]}
